issues.explanation: New CI workflows are unrelated to the entities task and should be a separate pull request.
Unrelated formatting-only change to the verification resend route.
Entity creation with membership does DB::transaction directly in Livewire instead of an app/Actions use-case class that authorizes inside.
Factory derives slug from name without unique guarantee, so two different names can collide despite contract requiring unique slug.
No unauthorized Livewire submit test for CreateEntity (guest submit) and no explicit tamper test for locked/param values.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:201 uses #[Validate]+validate() and authorize('create'); app/Policies/* used everywhere; migrations have down(); docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md updated; but app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:218 writes via DB::transaction directly with no app/Actions class

scope.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy-dev.yml:1 and .github/workflows/tests.yml:1 are unrelated CI additions; routes/web.php:1094 throttle array rewrite is unrelated; rest serves task

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityMembershipTest.php:1148 one-owner DB test; EntityOnboardingTest.php:1248 creation+owner+audit, 1287 slug suffix, 1303 race retry, 1237 validation; EntityPoliciesTest.php:1340-1458 all abilities; EntityTenantSessionTest.php:1505 home dispatch, 1579/1591 403s, 1624 pick audit, 1641 pick forbidden keeps session

review.summary: Implements the entity data model, single-owner DB constraint, policies, tenant session, onboarding with slug retry, switcher, dashboard and full lang/docs coverage with strong tests. Needs changes before merging: remove unrelated CI workflows, route domain writes through app/Actions per conventions, and make the entity factory slug unique.
